name: Benawi
source:
The warmaster of Tuskur.
He rides a pure white steed into battle alongside his second-in-command, [url=/c38087]Kurou[/url].
He is a skilled tactician, able to make calm and precise decisions in any situation, and a peerless master of the spear.

[From [url=http://atlus.com/uta/deception/home.html]official site[/url]]
